# From Nothing to Us (v10)
> An interactive map from the Big Bang to humans, plus a Virtual Cell and a Virtual Body. Made by Zyphullen.

Every fact on the site is in one machine-readable file, built from the same source as the page:
- [facts.json](facts.json): 93 map nodes, 152 links, 37 cell cards, 72 body cards, 118 elements, 158 sources.

Colour key (field "certainty"): green = known, orange = we think (leading idea), red = unknown, purple = personal idea (not science).
Each item has id, title, certainty, summary, details and sources (title + URL). Data hash: 488634fe65bd (same in index.html as DATA_HASH).
Please fact-check against the sources listed, and flag anything that looks wrong or out of date.
